description: StockX (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, list_orders. Every tool maps to a docu

platform_mcp_stockx_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_STOCKX_API_KEY
platform_mcp_stockx_api_key.description: StockX API key from the Developer Portal Keys page (issued after developer access approval), sent as x-api-key on every call.

platform_mcp_stockx_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_STOCKX_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_stockx_client_id.description: Client ID of your StockX application (Developer Portal > Applications; one application per StockX account).

platform_mcp_stockx_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_STOCKX_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_stockx_client_secret.description: Client Secret of the same application.

platform_mcp_stockx_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_STOCKX_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_stockx_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from a one-time Authorization Code consent (https://accounts.stockx.com/authorize with scope 'offline_access openid' and audience gateway.stockx.com, then POST /oauth/token grant_type=authorization_code). The runtime exchanges it for 12-hour access tokens (grant_type=refresh_token, audience=gateway.stockx.com).

platform_mcp_stockx_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_STOCKX_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_stockx_currency.description: Currency code of your asks (AUD, CAD, CHF, EUR, GBP, HKD, JPY, KRW, MXN, NZD, SGD, USD); StockX defaults to USD when omitted.

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no account endpoint; the probe reads one listing (GET /selling/listings?pageSize=1) with the minted token and x-api-key.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PATCH /selling/listings/{listingId} {amount (string), currencyCode} changes the ask price. Asynchronous: returns {listingId, operationId, operationStatus}. `title`, `description` and `quantity` are ignored (a listing is one ask on a catalogue variant).

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: PUT /selling/listings/{listingId}/deactivate removes the ask from the marketplace (asynchronous operation; the listing can be re-activated with PUT …/activate).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /selling/orders/active?pageNumber&pageSize(≤100)&orderStatus: orders from creation until payout. status: CREATED, CCAUTHORIZATIONFAILED, SHIPPED, RECEIVED, AUTHENTICATING, AUTHENTICATED, PAYOUTPENDING, PAYOUTCOMPLETED, SYSTEMFULFILLED, PAYOUTFAILED, SUSPENDED, PENDING, DONOTSHIP. `since` is ignored (only the historical-orders endpoint filters by date). amount is a string; product, variant and payout are in raw.
